items.title: Is Nvidia's AI data center dominance slipping as the market expands?
items.summary: Moor Insights & Strategy founder, CEO, and chief analyst Patrick Moorhead speaks with Josh Lipton about Nvidia's (NVDA) biggest competition in AI data centers, as he anticipates the company's market share could fall to 70% from 90% over the next two years.

items.title: The story that Nvidia's margins, balance sheet tell going into Q2 earnings

items.title: The real question investors should be asking ahead of Nvidia earnings

items.title: Moody’s (MCO) Is Up 5.6% After Embedding Credit Intelligence Into Google’s Gemini Enterprise Platform
items.summary: Moody’s Corporation recently made its connected intelligence available inside Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services via the Moody’s Credit Model Context Protocol server, giving users direct access to its credit ratings, research, and risk intelligence within their existing workflows.
